items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I worked vaudevilles with Bunny Berigan at Loew's State.

ctx.x: Yes, I did vaudeville. I used to be in Loew's State at least four times a year. And I was on a theater tour, more or less. You know, I was booked out of New York and I guess I must have been out on the road about two years doing vaudeville theaters. You know, jumping from one place to another. And, well vaudeville was still in. And so this gave me quite a broad experience of working with other musicians. I was always the featured attraction. And they were also having bands on the stage at the time. So I worked…
I also see in my notes here. I have Benny Goodman's name down. Did you work with him as a single somewhere along the line?
